verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the code is open source and can be self-hosted on PostgreSQL, hosted users can delete their data, the API aims for Sentry compatibility, and the MCP server lets AI tools pull error data. None of these is a documented bulk export for leaving the service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
